summary.zh-CN: 先概述再评价，评价必须落到具体文本；适合通识课与经典阅读课。
summary.en: Summarises first, then evaluates against specific passages; suited to general-education and reading courses.

whenToUse.zh-CN: 老师指定了书目并要求提交报告或书评
whenToUse.en: A specific book is assigned and a report or review is required

whenToUse.zh-CN: 重点是理解与评价而不是论证一个新观点
whenToUse.en: Understanding and evaluation matter more than a new argument

whenToUse.zh-CN: 读者假定没有读过原书
whenToUse.en: The reader is assumed not to have read the book

focus.zh-CN: 给出书目信息、作者背景与本次评价的角度，让读者知道后面要评判什么。
focus.en: Give the book details, author background and the angle of evaluation.

focus.zh-CN: 只提供理解评价所需的背景，不逐章复述，不透露结局。
focus.en: Give only the background needed to follow the evaluation; no chapter-by-chapter retelling.

focus.zh-CN: 结合具体文本与理由，说明什么奏效、与同类作品相比如何、在主题或情理上是否有说服力。
focus.en: Argue from specific passages what works, how it compares with similar works, and whether it persuades.

focus.zh-CN: 给出总体判断与推荐对象；如需出版信息，按老师要求列在文末。
focus.en: State the overall judgement and who should read it; add publication details if required.

methodNotes.zh-CN: 概述与评价的比例按作业要求调整，常见各占一半；本预设把评价放在更重的一侧。
methodNotes.en: The summary-to-evaluation ratio follows the assignment; this preset weights evaluation more heavily.
